question: LOT 목록 100건 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, LOTNAME, STATE, QTY FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 홀드 상태인 LOT 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, STATE, ISHOLD, QTY FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ISHOLD = 'Y'

question: 설비 전체 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 EQUIPMENTID, SITEID, EQUIPMENTNAME, STATE, EQUIPMENTCLASSID FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 설비 유형별 설비 수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT E.EQUIPMENTCLASSID, C.EQUIPMENTCLASSNAME, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT E WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_EQUIPMENTCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON E.EQUIPMENTCLASSID = C.EQUIPMENTCLASSID AND E.SITEID = C.SITEID GROUP BY E.EQUIPMENTCLASSID, C.EQUIPMENTCLASSNAME

question: 작업지시 전체 목록과 상태를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTORDERID, SITEID, PRODUCTORDERNAME, STATE, QTY, SCHEDULESTARTTIME, SCHEDULEENDTIME FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 완료 상태가 아닌 작업지시 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTORDERID, SITEID, PRODUCTORDERNAME, STATE, QTY FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE STATE NOT IN ('Finished', 'Closed', 'Complete')

question: 자재 LOT 중 현재 수량이 0인 것 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 MATERIALLOTID, SITEID, MATERIALDEFINITIONID, QTY, STATE FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE QTY = 0

question: 안전재고가 있는 자재 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 MATERIALDEFINITIONID, SITEID, MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, SAFETY_QTY FROM CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SAFETY_QTY > 0

question: 공정 세그먼트 전체 목록과 소요시간을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PROCESSSEGMENTID, SITEID, PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, LEADTIME, LEADTIMEUNIT FROM CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 불량 유형 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 DEFECTCLASSID, SITEID FROM CIM_DEFECTCLASS WITH (NOLOCK)
notes: CIM_DEFECTCLASS 컬럼은 스키마 보강 후 조정

question: 재작업 대상 LOT 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, ISREWORK, STATE, QTY FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ISREWORK = 'Y'

question: 공정 세그먼트별 불량 수량 합계를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PROCESSSEGMENTID, SUM(L.DEFECTQTY) AS 불량수량합계 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY L.PROCESSSEGMENTID

question: 최근 30일 TrackIn 된 LOT 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(day, -30, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())
notes: chat.py 날짜 규칙(1년 전 기준) 반영

question: LOT별 현재 설비 ID와 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, EQUIPMENTID, QTY, STATE FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENTID IS NOT NULL

question: 배치 전체 목록과 상태를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 BATCHID, SITEID, BATCHNAME, STATE, QTY FROM CIM_BATCH WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 유통기한이 지난 자재 LOT 목록 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 MATERIALLOTID, SITEID, EXPIREDATE, QTY FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EXPIREDATE < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())

question: 제품 정의 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTDEFINITIONID, SITEID, PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, PRODUCTCLASSID FROM CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 공정 정의별 공정 노드 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 N.PROCESSNODEID, N.PROCESSDEFINITIONID, N.PROCESSSEGMENTID, N.PROCESSNODESEQUENCE FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE N WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 작업지시별 LOT 수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PRODUCTORDERID, COUNT(*) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.PRODUCTORDERID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.PRODUCTORDERID

question: 설비별 TrackIn 건수 추이를 일별로 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT CONVERT(date, L.TRACKINTIME) AS 작업일자, L.EQUIPMENTID, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(day, -30, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) AND L.EQUIPMENTID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CONVERT(date, L.TRACKINTIME), L.EQUIPMENTID ORDER BY 작업일자, L.EQUIPMENTID
notes: RUNCOUNT 대신 TRACKINTIME 집계. 날짜=개발DB평가용(1년전 기준 30일창, MES_DATE_MODE=dev_last_year)

question: 지연된 작업지시 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTORDERID, SITEID, PRODUCTORDERNAME, DELAYFLAG, SCHEDULEENDTIME FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DELAYFLAG = 'Y'

question: 확정된 작업지시 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PRODUCTORDERID, SITEID, PRODUCTORDERNAME, FIRMFLAG, STATE FROM CIM_PRODUCTORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE FIRMFLAG = 'Y'

question: 품목 구분별 제품 정의 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT P.PRODUCTCLASSID, C.PRODUCTCLASSNAME, COUNT(*) AS 제품수 FROM CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.PRODUCTCLASSID = C.PRODUCTCLASSID AND P.SITEID = C.SITEID GROUP BY P.PRODUCTCLASSID, C.PRODUCTCLASSNAME

question: LOT ID와 제품명을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, L.SITEID, P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONNAME, L.QTY, L.STATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PRODUCTDEFINITION P WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID = P.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID AND L.SITEID = P.SITEID

question: 공정 정의 전체 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PROCESSDEFINITIONID, SITEID, PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME, PROCESSTYPE FROM CIM_PROCESSDEFINITION WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 제품별 기본 공정 라우팅 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID, R.PROCESSDEFINITIONID, R.ISDEFAULT, R.SEQUENCE FROM CIM_PRODUCTPROCESSREL R WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE R.ISDEFAULT = 'Y'

question: LOT과 배치 연결 관계 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, R.BATCHID, R.SITEID, R.QTY FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 배치별 연결된 LOT 수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT R.BATCHID, COUNT(*) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_LOTBATCHREL R WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY R.BATCHID

question: LOT이 소비한 자재 LOT 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.LOTID, R.MATERIALLOTID, R.SITEID, R.QTY, R.PROCESSSEGMENTID FROM CIM_LOTMATERIALLOTREL R WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 자재 분류별 자재 정의 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT M.MATERIALCLASSID, C.MATERIALCLASSNAME, COUNT(*) AS 자재수 FROM CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION M WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALCLASS C WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.MATERIALCLASSID = C.MATERIALCLASSID AND M.SITEID = C.SITEID GROUP BY M.MATERIALCLASSID, C.MATERIALCLASSNAME

question: 알람이 설정된 설비 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 EQUIPMENTID, SITEID, EQUIPMENTNAME, ALARMID, STATE FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ALARMID IS NOT NULL AND ALARMID <> ''

question: 예방정비 PM 대상 설비 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 EQUIPMENTID, SITEID, EQUIPMENTNAME, PMTARGET, STATE FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE PMTARGET IS NOT NULL AND PMTARGET <> ''

question: 공정 구역 전체 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 FACILITYID, SITEID, FACILITYNAME, FACILITYTYPE FROM CIM_FACILITY WITH (NOLOCK)

question: LOT별 불량률을 계산해서 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, ORIGINALQTY, LOSSQTY, CASE WHEN ORIGINALQTY > 0 THEN CAST(LOSSQTY AS float) / ORIGINALQTY * 100 ELSE 0 END AS 불량률 FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ORIGINALQTY > 0

question: TrackOut 완료된 LOT 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, TRACKOUTTIME, QTY, STATE FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TRACKOUTTIME IS NOT NULL

question: 납기일이 지난 LOT 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 LOTID, SITEID, DUEDATE, QTY, STATE FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DUEDATE < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())

question: 공정 노드와 공정 세그먼트 이름을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 N.PROCESSNODEID, N.PROCESSDEFINITIONID, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, N.PROCESSNODESEQUENCE FROM CIM_PROCESSNODE N WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON N.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND N.SITEID = S.SITEID

question: 공정 경로 전체 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PROCESSPATHID, PROCESSNODEID, NEXTPROCESSNODEID, SITEID, ISAUTODISPATCH FROM CIM_PROCESSPATH WITH (NOLOCK)

question: 자동 디스패치가 설정된 공정 경로를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 PROCESSPATHID, PROCESSNODEID, NEXTPROCESSNODEID, ISAUTODISPATCH FROM CIM_PROCESSPATH WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ISAUTODISPATCH = 'Y'

question: LOT의 공정명과 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, S.PROCESSSEGMENTNAME, L.QTY, L.STATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSSEGMENT S WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PROCESSSEGMENTID = S.PROCESSSEGMENTID AND L.SITEID = S.SITEID

question: 제품 정의별 LOT 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID, COUNT(*) AS LOT건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID

question: 설비 상태별 설비 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT STATE, COUNT(*) AS 설비수 FROM CIM_EQUIPMENT WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY STATE

question: 배치 상태별 배치 개수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT STATE, COUNT(*) AS 배치수 FROM CIM_BATCH WITH (NOLOCK) GROUP BY STATE

question: 자재 LOT과 자재명을 함께 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 ML.MATERIALLOTID, MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONNAME, ML.QTY, ML.STATE FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT ML WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_MATERIALDEFINITION MD WITH (NOLOCK) ON ML.MATERIALDEFINITIONID = MD.MATERIALDEFINITIONID AND ML.SITEID = MD.SITEID

question: 최근 7일 이내 입고된 자재 LOT을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 MATERIALLOTID, SITEID, RECEIVEDTIME, QTY FROM CIM_MATERIALLOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE RECEIVEDTIME >= DATEADD(day, -7, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND RECEIVEDTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())

question: 공정 세그먼트별 LOT 평균 수량을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT L.PROCESSSEGMENTID, AVG(L.QTY) AS 평균수량 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.PROCESSSEGMENTID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY L.PROCESSSEGMENTID

question: 작업지시와 연결된 LOT 상세 목록을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 L.LOTID, O.PRODUCTORDERID, O.PRODUCTORDERNAME, L.QTY, L.STATE FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN CIM_PRODUCTORDER O WITH (NOLOCK) ON L.PRODUCTORDERID = O.PRODUCTORDERID AND L.SITEID = O.SITEID

question: 제품별 공정 정의 이름을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 100 R.PRODUCTDEFINITIONID, R.PROCESSDEFINITIONID, D.PROCESSDEFINITIONNAME, R.ISDEFAULT FROM CIM_PRODUCTPROCESSREL R WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN CIM_PROCESSDEFINITION D WITH (NOLOCK) ON R.PROCESSDEFINITIONID = D.PROCESSDEFINITIONID AND R.SITEID = D.SITEID

question: 월별 TrackIn 건수를 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(L.TRACKINTIME) AS 연도, MONTH(L.TRACKINTIME) AS 월, COUNT(*) AS 건수 FROM CIM_LOT L WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE L.TRACKINTIME >= DATEADD(month, -12, DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE())) AND L.TRACKINTIME < DATEADD(year, -1, GETDATE()) GROUP BY YEAR(L.TRACKINTIME), MONTH(L.TRACKINTIME) ORDER BY 연도, 월

question: 홀드 상태 LOT 중 불량 수량 상위 10건을 보여줘
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 10 LOTID, SITEID, ISHOLD, DEFECTQTY, LOSSQTY, QTY FROM CIM_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ISHOLD = 'Y' ORDER BY DEFECTQTY DESC
